systemUnderTest: the per-user representation feature end-to-end (USER-01 adapter + USER-02 builder + USER-03 LLM-free injection + USER-04 daemon wiring + keyless gate)

models.note: The model block records the INTENDED costed-pass configuration (the same answerer + cross-MODEL judge pair as the 2026-06-01-phase106-baser baseline). The KEYLESS run that backs this manifest calls NO model: the offline builder's build() seam is an INJECTED stub (a pure fn returning fixed candidates), the fixtures are synthetic, and the injection path is the pure buildUserRepresentationBlock formatter. cross-PROVIDER judging with claude-opus-4-8 is the costed re-run — opus is used as a judge ONLY when the answer lane is non-Anthropic (BUG-004: an answerer must never be its own provider's judge).

measurementsTaken.name: prefix-typing round-trips
measurementsTaken.result: PASS — 4 prefix-types (identity/preference/relationship/instruction) upserted via the SOLE adapter; the (tenant, agent, user)-scoped read returns all 4 typed. Mechanical, keyless, $0 — NOT a QA-accuracy lift.

measurementsTaken.name: external REJECTED (anti-poisoning)
measurementsTaken.result: PASS — a forged external-trust upsert is rejected at the write boundary (the high-trust floor + the DB CHECK), AND a builder run over an external-only source set writes 0 rows (the job's unconditional external-exclude runs BEFORE the build seam — the excluded content never reaches it). Mechanical, keyless, $0 — NOT a QA-accuracy lift.

measurementsTaken.name: redaction-clean (the redaction firewall on every candidate)
measurementsTaken.result: PASS — validateMemoryWrite flags a secret-shaped candidate; the builder SKIPS it (blocked++), NEVER down-stores it (the USER Pitfall-2 hardening — a warn/critical verdict has no reduced-weight tier, unlike the KG reasoning job). The secret-shaped content is never present in the store. Mechanical, keyless, $0 — NOT a QA-accuracy lift.

measurementsTaken.name: (tenant, agent, user) 3-way isolation
measurementsTaken.result: PASS — a row written under scope A is ABSENT across all three foreign axes (cross-tenant=0, cross-agent=0, cross-user=0) and PRESENT in-scope (=1). The per-user partition is enforced in SQL (every adapter statement filters on tenant_id AND agent_id AND user_id). Mechanical, keyless, $0 — NOT a QA-accuracy lift.

measurementsTaken.name: default-OFF byte-identity (the cost gate)
measurementsTaken.result: PASS — with no profile rows the pure formatter returns null (nothing pushed -> byte-identical prompt); the <user_profile> block diverges ONLY when the store returns rows. The no-regression-by-construction proof: with the feature off, the prompt is unchanged. Mechanical, keyless, $0 — NOT a QA-accuracy lift.

measurementsTaken.name: LLM-free injection (the milestone's #1 binding constraint)
measurementsTaken.result: PASS — the read+format path makes 0 build()/model calls (only store.read + the pure formatter run; a build seam is provided but never touched). The recall hot path stays LLM-free. Mechanical, keyless, $0 — NOT a QA-accuracy lift.

measurementsDeferredToOperatorCostedReRu.name: LongMemEval preference-recall accuracy lift (the costed QA delta)
measurementsDeferredToOperatorCostedReRu.why: Needs a real answer model (to answer preference-category questions WITH vs WITHOUT the standing <user_profile> block), a real LLM judge (cross-judge >=2 per the credibility protocol), AND the offline builder run with a real cheap cron model (not the keyless stub seam) to populate profiles from a real high-trust source set. All three cost real spend + keys. The keyless bench stubs the build seam and uses synthetic fixtures, so it proves the MECHANISM at $0 but produces no accuracy number; a fresh accuracy number here would be fabricated.
measurementsDeferredToOperatorCostedReRu.reproductionCommand: populate scripts/bench-memory.env (COMIS_BENCH + COMIS_BENCH_ANSWER_* + COMIS_BENCH_JUDGE_* variable NAMES), enable agents.<id>.memoryUserRepresentation.enabled + run the __USER_REPRESENTATION__ cron with a real cron model, then run the LongMemEval preference-category QA harness WITH vs WITHOUT the <user_profile> block under the answer model + two judges; record per-category accuracy delta + N + significance + cost + latency.
measurementsDeferredToOperatorCostedReRu.baselineToDiffAgainst: benchmarks/results/2026-06-01-phase106-baser/ (overall 71.1/73.3, recall@5 0.845, single-session-preference 30/45 UNSTABLE — the preference category is the target axis, flagged cross-judge UNSTABLE at 15pt, so a lift must clear that noise band)

coi.disclosure: Comis authored this benchmark harness. No competitor number, no cross-judged accuracy delta, and no comparative-ranking framing appears anywhere in this manifest (binding constraint #8). The per-user representation feature is measured only against itself (ON vs OFF mechanics) and the v2.9 baseline it must not move when off.
coi.ossLicense: Apache-2.0 harness — the keyless bench (user-representation-contribution.bench.test.ts) carries an SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 header so the mechanical claims are independently reproducible at $0.
coi.rawTranscriptRelease: On the operator-costed re-run, the raw answer + judge transcripts for the preference-recall lift are released alongside the dated row under benchmarks/results/history/<date>-<commit>.json so any accuracy number is auditable end-to-end.

honestyProtocol: Every number traces to a committed claim*-report.json, read back from disk before quoting. The six mechanical claims (prefix-typing, external-reject, redaction-clean, 3-way isolation, default-OFF byte-identity, LLM-free injection) are each labelled 'mechanical, keyless, $0 — NOT a QA-accuracy lift' and kept STRICTLY SEPARATE from the costed preference-recall accuracy lift, which is explicitly 'not measured — operator costed re-run', NOT a guessed delta. The keyless bench calls no answer model, no judge, no key, no provider (grep COMIS_BENCH_*_API_KEY over the bench returns 0). A post-run credential-shape sweep over the manifest is clean: it carries pure numbers + booleans + prose, no credential field names or secret-key/bearer-token shapes.
